author: NDIS Quality and Safeguards Commission
title: Reportable incidents
relevance: Australian incident notification timeframes and five-day form.
limitations: Official regulator guidance; apply with final rules and safeguarding advice.

author: NDIS Quality and Safeguards Commission
title: Mandatory registration and transition pathways for NDIS digital platforms
limitations: Page summary still references draft definitions; does not establish this provider’s certificate or pathway.

author: NDIA
title: Pricing arrangements
date: Page updated 22 Jul 2026; schedule effective 1 Jul 2026
limitations: Landing page checked; every code rate was not reconciled to every detailed item/rule.

author: Fair Work Ombudsman
title: Hours of work in the SCHADS Award
date: Changes from first full pay period on/after 1 Jun 2026
relevance: Sleepover continuity, hours, overtime and rest review.
limitations: Apply to actual employment arrangements; further Commission proceedings remain.

author: W3C
title: Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.2
limitations: A target standard, not a certification of this site.

author: W3C
title: Making Content Usable for People with Cognitive and Learning Disabilities
relevance: Clear steps, help, understandable language and user involvement.
limitations: Informative guidance; supplements WCAG, not an additional mandatory conformance level.

author: W3C
title: Web Authentication: An API for accessing Public Key Credentials — Level 3
limitations: Browser capabilities and recovery must still be tested; passkeys did not begin with this version.

author: NIST
title: Digital Identity Guidelines, SP 800-63 Revision 4
relevance: Authentication and recovery assurance; syncable authenticators.
limitations: US technical guidance, not an Australian statutory mandate.

author: OWASP
title: Application Security Verification Standard
limitations: Control framework; not evidence that this site complies.

author: Lukac et al.
title: Ambient AI Scribes in Clinical Practice: A Randomized Trial
limitations: 238 outpatient physicians, 14 specialties; not an NDIS study. Abstract-level appraisal; full-text endpoint challenged browser.

author: Ulloa-Pérez et al.
title: Pragmatic Randomized Study of Targeted Text Message Reminders to Reduce Missed Clinic Visits
date: The Permanente Journal, 5 Apr 2022; data collected 2019
relevance: Targeted extra reminders reduced missed visits in a US health system.
limitations: Single-system high-risk visits; no guarantee of effect in disability home support; not percentage-point effects.

author: Hsiao et al.
title: Preferences for Personalized Text Message Appointment Reminders Among Outpatients in a Universal Health System: Cross-Sectional Study
relevance: Reminder preferences differ; test content locally.
limitations: 1,095 respondents in Taiwan; online convenience sample, excludes known cognitive impairments; preference, not attendance efficacy.

author: Chapman et al.
title: Beyond a buzzword: the need for shared language, education, and enhanced reporting of disability inclusive co-design research
relevance: Accountable disability-inclusive co-design and decision reporting.
limitations: Commentary, not a controlled effectiveness study.

author: OAIC
title: Guidance on privacy and the use of commercially available AI products
relevance: Privacy assessment, appropriate data use, accuracy and human oversight.
limitations: Provider-specific due diligence required; a region label is not assurance.

author: Google web.dev
title: Interaction to Next Paint (INP)
relevance: Measure real interaction latency; good INP <=200 ms at the 75th percentile.
limitations: Field performance was not measured in this audit.

author: OAIC
title: What is a health service provider?
relevance: Privacy Act scope can include small health service providers.
limitations: Assess actual services and information held; not a legal classification of The Care Web.
